description: Network Losses is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction This dataset contains the total losses across the network. Distributing electricity across a large area inevitably leads to electrical 'losses'. In simple terms, the energy entering our network is higher than the energy received by our customers and this is what we call a 'loss'. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2024-01-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
